title: Titanium Reactor Lining Plate
function: Explosion-bonded PTA reactor lining plate (Gr 7 clad)
alloyReason: Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni (UNS R53400) is selected for Titanium Reactor Lining Plate in chemical processing environments where resistance to HCl and H₂SO₄ at temperatures up to 200°C exceeds the capability of CP grades. The molybdenum and nickel additions stabilize the passive film under reducing acid conditions, extending service life in Explosion-bonded PTA reactor lining plate (Gr 7 clad) by 3-5× versus unalloyed titanium. This rationale is driven by explosion-bonded pta reactor lining plate (gr 7 clad) and specific design requirements.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for reactor hardware geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with Class 6g gauge
TIG welding Grade 2 with Class 6g gauge
Hydrostatic shell test with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for explosionbonded pta reactor application
commonFailures: Crevice under gasket seating surface - mitigated by raised-face flange 0.5mm step replacing full-face gasket — critical for explosionbonded pta reactor performance

faq.q: What inspection and testing is available for Titanium Reactor Lining Plate pressure-containing components?
faq.a: Titanium Reactor Lining Plate can be supplied with hydrostatic pressure testing at 1.3× design pressure per ASME B31.3, PMI (positive material identification) via OES analyzer on 100% of production, ultrasonic wall thickness scanning, and helium leak testing to 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s. For explosionbonded pta reactor, 100% PMI + hydrostatic testing is the standard specification.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Reactor Lining Plate orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Reactor Lining Plate is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Reactor Lining Plate?
faq.a: Each Titanium Reactor Lining Plate shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for explosionbonded pta reactor.
